name: drt-loom
description: A framework for generating Synthetic Industrial Reasoning Environments, with a reference benchmark implementation. Deterministic generation of industrial enterprises spanning ERP, PLM, MES, CAD and enterprise documents, for evaluating cross-domain reasoning in Industrial Agentic AI.

scripts.build:all: npm run gen && npm run graph
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run verify && npm run verify:seeds && npm run verify:domains && npm run verify:config
